description: This file contains function declarations, include statements, and licensing information for a module that provides wrappers around nl80211 APIs used to control Wi-Fi endpoints, such as sending management frames, setting station configurations, retrieving interface and station information, and managing 4Mac configurations. It is part of a Wi-Fi driver or management subsystem.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a Wi-Fi management frame with specific parameters using the nl80211 interface.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Configures station settings for the endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Configures 4Mac settings for the endpoint, optionally using 4 Mac addresses.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information including MLO link details for the endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a remote AP based on MAC address.
